summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; reject admission of the totaljerks.com CTA change this cycle; allow only bounded, no-spend, no-credential, no-dependency, no-configuration, no-tracking, no-cross-site work after capacity and measurement evidence are resolved. Do not claim clearance, certification, or absence of vulnerabilities.

The proposed totaljerks.com CTA change is not security-blocked by a known vulnerability, but it is not admissible this cycle because capacity and measurement evidence are unresolved. Retain only as planning context; do not create or execute an implementation request until the authoritative slot count and existing CTA measurement are evidenced.
